[[File:Tomb Raider Collectible Card Game Premier logo.png|thumb|Original Tomb Raider CCG game logo.]]
'''Tomb Raider Collectible Card Game''' is an adventure card game based on the ''Tomb Raider'' video games. Precedence Entertainment first published it in 1999.<ref name="releases">[https://www.virtuallara.com/tomb-raider-trading-card-game.html Tomb Raider Collectible Card Games], Virtual Lara. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260923033833/https://www.virtuallara.com/tomb-raider-trading-card-game.html Internet Archive].</ref> David Hewitt designed the game.<ref>[https://www.econ.pitt.edu/sites/default/files/CVs/hewitt_cv_210501.pdf David Hewitt curriculum vitae], University of Pittsburgh, p. 3. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240819032152/https://www.econ.pitt.edu/sites/default/files/CVs/hewitt_cv_210501.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Gameplay ==

Players take the role of Lara Croft or a rival and explore tombs and caves in search of treasure. Each raider brings a deck and faces traps, wild animals, and other obstacles. The game supports solo and competitive play.<ref name="core-design">[https://core-design.com/goodies_cardgame.html Tomb Raider Collectible Card Game], Core Design. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260314082709/https://core-design.com/goodies_cardgame.html Internet Archive].</ref>

== Publication ==

The first set was followed by ''Slippery When Wet'' and ''Big Guns''. ''Big Guns'' appeared in 2000. Precedence announced that it had sold out of the line by the 2001 GAMA Trade Show and discontinued further expansions because of production and licensing issues.<ref name="releases" /><ref>[https://www.nslists.com/tombrcc3.htm Tomb Raider Collectible Card Game: Big Guns Expansion], checklist. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260107100921/https://www.nslists.com/tombrcc3.htm Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="core-design" />

== Online play ==

The [[TCGMix]] playtest offers bot games with starter decks and includes some cards from ''Premier'', ''Slippery When Wet'' and ''Big Guns''.<ref name="catalog" />

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/tombraider/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-tomb-raider-ccg">[https://tcgmix.com/tombraider/ Play Tomb Raider CCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107195122/https://tcgmix.com/tombraider/ Internet Archive].</ref>
